map.按月龄段调整尺码：宝宝体重增长快，NB/S 码窗口短（多在 0–4 月），需根据: Adjust the size by age bracket: babies gain weight fast and the NB/S window is short (mostly 0-4 months), so switch to M/L early using the weight reference table to prevent leaks or leg marks.
map.出差/旅行打包：按出行天数×每日用量上浮 20% 备货，并随行多带一包下一尺码以: Business trips and travel packing: stock up at travel days x daily usage plus 20%, and bring an extra pack of the next size in case the baby suddenly outgrows it.
map.6 月龄、单价 2 元/片、未来 30 天用量: Age 6 months, unit price 2 CNY per diaper, usage over the next 30 days
map.输入月龄 6、单价 2、天数 30。分段规则：7–12 月每日约 5.5 片，取: Enter age 6, unit price 2, days 30. Bracketing rule: 7-12 months is about 5.5 diapers per day, and the 6-month bracket takes 7 per day (the 4-6 month band). Total usage = ceil(7 x 30) = 210 diapers; cost = 210 x 2 = 420 CNY; recommended size M (6-11 kg, 4-10 months). That is about 210 diapers over 30 days at a cost of about 420 CNY.
map.为什么不同月龄每日片数差这么多？: Why do the daily diaper counts differ so much by age?
map.新生儿排泄频繁（约 10–12 片/天），随肠道发育与喂养规律建立，1–3 月约: Newborns pass frequently (about 10-12 diapers per day); as the gut develops and a feeding routine forms, 1-3 months is about 8-10, 4-6 months about 6-8, 7-12 months about 5-6, and after age 1 about 4-5. This tool uses common bracketing experience values, but the actual change frequency of your baby is the final criterion.
